_doc: Regions re-OCR'd by tools/ocr_fix.py (300 DPI render + tools/ocr_region). dropcap: the two lines beside a chapter's drop cap, found automatically inside `search`; cap_keep < 1 when a stroke of the cap touches the next line. block: every line inside `box`, OCR'd `scale` times enlarged. Boxes are normalized [x, y, w, h], top-left origin. See book/_kiem-tra.md.
